title: Armor and stuff
description:
Adds adamantite, Spawning at a minimum of 65 blocks and a maximum of 70 blocks, With this ore, You will be able to craft adamanite armour, Rivaling diamond in strength. 

it also adds toasters, which can be used to toast bread, making it give more food.
body:
Adds adamantite, Spawning at a minimum of 65 blocks and a maximum of 70 blocks, With this ore, You will be able to craft adamanite armour, Rivaling diamond in strength. 

it also adds toasters, which can be used to toast bread, making it give more food.
